history.longComment: Gadjovich hasn't played since Oct. 25, 2025 because of the injury. He had three assists, seven PIM and 30 hits in 10 regular-season appearances last campaign. Gadjovich is expected to see time on the fourth line once he's available.

history.shortComment: Head coach Scott Arniel said Friday that Salomonsson (shoulder) is ahead of schedule in his recovery and could be ready to play by mid-October, Mike McIntyre of the Winnipeg Free Press reports.
history.longComment: Salomonsson was initially targeting a return to game action around late October, but he could be in the mix to suit up a few weeks earlier than expected. The 22-year-old was skating in a regular sweater early in training camp, and he's expected to join the main group for practice in a non-contact sweater Sunday, per Ken Wiebe of The Winnipeg Free Press.

history.shortComment: Gustavsson (hip) was placed on injured reserve Monday, according to Dylan Loucks of The Hockey News.
history.longComment: Gustavsson is expected to be out until at least early November. He posted a 28-15-6 record with two shutouts, a 2.69 GAA and a .903 save percentage in 50 appearances for Minnesota during the 2025-26 regular season. Once he returns, Gustavsson will be in the mix for starts with Jesper Wallstedt.

history.shortComment: Faber (upper body) will begin the 2026-27 regular season on injured reserve, per Dylan Loucks of The Hockey News.
history.longComment: Faber suffered the upper body injury during Friday's preseason matchup against the Stars. While he stayed in the game until the end of the second intermission, the issue has been revealed to be serious enough to keep him off the ice for Opening Night. It's a tough loss for the Wild's defensive unit, as Faber had a career year in the 2025-26 season with 15 goals, 51 points, 173 shots on net and 148 blocked shots across 80 regular-season games. His status will be monitored closely until more information about his timetable for return is released. Regardless, he will likely return to a role on the team's top pairing next to Quinn Hughes when healthy.

history.shortComment: O'Brien (lower body) was placed on injured reserve on Sunday.
history.longComment: O'Brien was held out of Seattle's lineup for their preseason contest Thursday. The 19-year-old center was exceptional with OHL Brantford in 2025-26, where he compiled 28 goals and 93 points across 53 regular-season games. Once O'Brien is ready to go, the Kraken will have to decide whether they want to try him out with their current roster, or push off his NHL debut by potentially optioning him to AHL Coachella Valley.
